title: Performance of 42 MLD Bardenpho process, Kelowna STP, Canada
markdown:
| Parameter | Unit | Influent | Effluent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TSS | mg/l | 350.0 | 2.0 |
| BOD₅ | mg/l | 186.0 | 5.0 |
| T-P | mg/l | 8.50 | 0.14 |
| T-N | mg/l | 36.39 | 4.03 |
| Faecal Coliform | cfu/100ml | N/A | 0.2 |
notes: Printed below the table: 'Flow Capacity: 42 MLD', 'Process configuration: Bardenpho process + Dual media filtration process + UV disinfection process'.
Source printed below the table: 'Source: Environmental Operators Certification Program http://www.eocp.org/plants-kelowna.html'.
Decimal places differ by parameter as printed (350.0, 2.0; 8.50, 0.14; 36.39, 4.03) and are retained.
'N/A' is printed for the influent Faecal Coliform cell; retained.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page render and 300-420 dpi crops; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: All five rows, units and the block below the table read from a 420 dpi crop.
